changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.turanix_setting ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, base_url TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, secret_key TEXT, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.turanix_check ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, user_id UUID, msisdn TEXT, pinfl TEXT, pass_ser TEXT, pass_num TEXT, status TEXT, result_code INTEGER, description TEXT, error_message TEXT, request JSONB, response JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMP );

changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_turanix_check_user_id ON integration.turanix_check (user_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_turanix_check_msisdn ON integration.turanix_check (msisdn);
